column1: # Typed slots for quarantined pilot topics (ADR-0039 slot-audit protocol).
# This is the manual review gate the importer deliberately refuses to
# automate: a topic leaves missing_typed_slots only when an editor has
# assigned its predicate slots. The column scheme mirrors the audited
# profile (qxfx0-plan-v2 era: qxfx0-semantic/assets/argued_topics.tsv):
#   topic           normalized pilot topic, must be a review-passed candidate
#   predicate_id    stable semantic id of the chosen source predicate
#   subject_id      seed graph atom id of the topic (verified to exist)
#   relation_id     semantic id of the head relation
#   object_id       semantic id of the governed object
#   thesis_surface  VERBATIM russian surface from the source row (the
#                   importer re-checks it against the corpus row and
#                   rejects a paraphrase as audited_surface_not_in_source_row)
# Measurement only: `import_haskell_corpus.py --typed-slots <this file>`
# merges these rows into the audited index for quarantine re-measurement.
# Nothing here promotes a topic; activation remains a separately reviewed
# catalog lifecycle decision.
topic
доказательство
воспроизводимость
выбор
закон
